## Requirements

### R-2.9.4⁰ᵃ — benchmark/environment schemas (§5h.4 §9 C0/S1 row)
1. `EnvironmentFamily` closed sum {coding_terminal, browser_computer,
   search_research, structured_tool, persistent_multi_episode,
   adversarial_security, long_running_recovery}.
2. `EnvironmentFamilyRecord` {family_id, version, requires: HandleRequirements
   (tri-state names ⊆ the closed capability set), oracle_classes_available,
   submission_kind, verifier_isolation_default, process_metrics[],
   fault_profiles_admissible[], perturbation_profiles_admissible[],
   episode_model, provenance} — a registered `environment_family` record kind.
3. `TaskRecord` {task_id, foreign{…}, family, tags[], split_label ∈
   {dev, search, held_out, public, private, control}, environment:
   EnvironmentSpec, visible{instruction[Text], attachments[], task_metadata_scope},
   held_out{validators, fixtures, goal_state?, oracle_solution?, never_delivered},
   instrument{grader: AdapterGraderSpec, budget_defaults, verify_budget,
   validity: TaskValidity, contamination{first_public_at?, stratum}, …},
   provenance, ext}; `task_id` = semantic-projection id (canonical record minus
   `foreign`, `instrument.validity/contamination`, `provenance`).
4. `SuiteManifest` / `SuiteValidityRecord` / `SplitAssignmentRecord` —
   content-addressed; split_hash over the splits map.
5. Contamination strata {private_held_out, fresh_temporal, public_dated,
   contaminated_public, unknown}; `training_cutoff_claim{value?, provenance ∈
   {provider_stated, inferred, unknown}}` on the snapshot record/claim.
6. L1 predicate — `held_out.*` never delivered/materialized (`HeldOutLeak` exists
   in `hh-verification::gate`; the import-side `HeldOutInEnvironment` static check
   lands with the records).
7. L2 check — `BenchmarkConditionedRule`/`C-LCD-4` already lands in
   `hh-assembly::validate` (7-L2); verify it covers AC-R-2.9.4-2 (conditioned
   HarnessRule on `suite_id`/`task_id`/`split`/`family` fails seal;
   `applies_to_families` on a variant is the admitted form).
8. `verifier_isolation` default rule: `separate` wherever `submission_kind ≠ none`;
   `shared` admissible only where the family declares it (schema half).

### R-2.9.6⁰ᵃ — assumption-debt schemas (§5h.6 §9 C0/S1 row)
9. `DebtHomes/1` — the closed 17-home inventory as data (`DebtHome` rows:
   record kind · field, default debt_class, default expiry_condition, default
   RemovalTest.kind); `UnknownDebtHome` for debt on an unlisted kind.
10. `AssumptionDebtRecord/1` — ratified fields `{rule_id, hypothesis: Text,
    evidence_refs[], owner, expiry_condition{kind, value?}, removal_test_ref,
    status ∈ {active, expiring, expired, retired}}` + additive optional fields
    `{debt_class, hypothesis_typed{subject, deficiency_class, predicted_effect},
    scope{model_selectors?, task_classes?, roles?}, expiry{condition, params},
    runway_ms, revalidation{on, action}, removal_test, created_by, created_at,
    supersedes?}`; `evidence_refs[]` typed as `EvidenceRef{kind, ref, observed_at?,
    tier?, provisional?}`; `owner: PrincipalRef | TeamRef` (+ `reach_via` sinks —
    OQ-446 interim).
11. `DeficiencyClass/1` — closed 12-sum incl. `unknown{…}` (inline explanation;
    `unknown` admissible only with `evidence_grade = hypothesized`).
12. `evidence_grade` — derived, never stored: hypothesized / evidenced /
    confirmed per the instrument-ref rule.
13. `RemovalTest` closed sum (12 kinds) + `RemovalVerdict` {debt_ref, kind,
    verdict ∈ {pass, fail, inconclusive{reason}}, report_ref, settled_at} +
    `RetirementRecord` {removal_test_report_ref, verdict_ref, decided_by: human
    provenance, rationale: Text}.
14. `validate_removal_test` — static/dry-run instantiation at `seal`/`register`:
    member-level checks always (beneficiaries ⊆ scope, missing snapshot scope
    where required, well-formedness) + context-parameterized resolution checks
    (`UnresolvedTemplate`, `MissingMatchSpec`, `NotARetirementDiff`,
    `UnresolvedProbeRef`, `UnresolvedZeroUseScope`, `MissingSplitAssignment`,
    `UnsealedArtifact`); `InsufficientRunway` (`until − created_at <
    min_runway`); `OwnerUnreachable`.
15. `DebtPolicy` schema {required_fields_by_home, min_runway,
    hypothesized_max_age, evidence_max_age, warn_within, grace_period,
    max_open_removal_tests, priority, notice_sinks, schedule,
    dead_weight_designs_allowed} with declared defaults (proposed placeholders
    per the ADR-0214 deferral text — recorded).
16. `lifecycle.debt.*` event classes (status.changed, removal_test.scheduled,
    removal_test.settled, expired_used) — ledger, provenance-mandatory.
17. `AssumptionDebtHealth` declarations (the `debt.*` metric names list).
18. `lcd_report.conditioned_rules[]` gains `evidence_grade` +
    `removal_test.executable` (hh-compiler::link).
19. Canonical vocabulary unification: `ExpiryKind`/`ExpiryCondition`/`DebtStatus`
    become the one canonical set (hh-ontology::debt); `hh-compiler::profile`
    re-exports; `hh_hir::DebtStatus` (3-value interim) is replaced; legacy
    spellings decode with a documented mapping.

### R-2.9.8⁰ — snapshot/compatibility schemas (§5h.8)
20. `SnapshotClaim` — additive extension of `ModelDiscoveryClaim`:
    {provider, model_id, snapshot_id, serving_route?, base_snapshot_ref?,
    training_lineage?{training_run_ref, step, data_refs[], method,
    compute_claim{confidence = reported}}, trained_under[]?,
    training_cutoff_claim?, weights_digest?: ForeignRef,
    policy_version_exposed ∈ {supported, unsupported, unknown}} +
    `ForeignRef{system, digest, label?, provenance}` (a claim, never a
    ContentAddress — I-2).
21. `CompatibilityRecord` — `conformance_report{subject_kind: snapshot_pair}`
    shape: {snapshot_ref, definition semantic_id, profile semantic_id, status ∈
    {trained_under, verified, drifted{rules[]}, broken{report_ref}, unknown},
    evidence_ref?, regression_suite_ref?, created_at, expiry_condition?,
    provenance} (`SubjectKind::SnapshotPair` already exists in hh-registry).

### R-2.10.3⁰ᵃ — experiment schemas (§6.3 §9 C0/S1 row)
22. `ExperimentSpec` (dialect `hh-experiment/1`) {kind ∈ {comparative,
    exploratory, equivalence, retirement, reproduction}, design: Design,
    pre_registration?, factors[FactorSpec{kind ∈ 6 FactorKinds, granularity?,
    role?, levels[LevelSpec{level_id, ref, overrides?, label, class,
    non_portable?}]}], arms[ArmSpec{arm_id, hypothesis, level_assignment,
    eval_budget, search_budget, match_spec, artifact_ref, limits_enforced,
    model_role_table_ref}], suite: SuiteBinding, replicates_per_cell,
    seed_policy, validation_strategy, scheduling: SchedulingPolicy,
    reattempt: ReattemptPolicy, budgets{experiment, instrument}, bundle_policy,
    ext}; `experiment_id = H(canonical(spec))`.
23. `CellPlan`/`RunPlan`/`OrderPlan` {plan_id, cells[Cell{cell_id, arm_id,
    configuration_id, configuration_version_id, task_id, split_label}],
    run_plans[RunPlan{run_plan_id, cell_id, replicate_index, seed_material,
    environment_derivation = fresh_from_image, cache_scope_salt}],
    order{permutation_seed, blocks}, generators?, aliasing_table?};
    `run_plan_id = H(experiment_id ∥ arm_id ∥ configuration_version_id ∥
    task_id ∥ replicate_index)` (scheduling/transport fields excluded).
24. The closed `register` refusal set (typed enum): MissingMatchSpec,
    UnbudgetedArm, UnmatchedBudget, IncommensurableMatch, MissingPricingTable,
    InadmissibleFactor, MissingPreRegistration, SplitUnassigned, LeakedSplit,
    UnsealedArtifact, InsufficientReplicates, ResolutionInsufficient,
    ProfilePinnedAcrossProfiles, DependsOnDriftedCapability, NotARetirementDiff,
    AdaptiveOutsideSearch — schema-checkable subset implemented against a
    `SpecContext` view; context-dependent refusals surface through the ctx.
25. `run_kind` — `RunKind::Experiment` exists (landed); the manifest gains the
    typed `experiment` member (experiment-run fields + subject-run binding
    fields — the R-2.10.5⁰ row-key fields' manifest source).

### R-2.10.4⁰ᵃ — analysis schemas (§6.4 §9 C0/S1 row)
26. `AnalysisSpec`/`AnalysisReport`/`QuerySpec`/`watermark_set`/`Cell`/

27. `ComparisonReport` — the full amended shape: {arm_a, arm_b, metric, pairing,

### R-2.10.5⁰ — row-key fields (§6.5 §9 / §9.2)
30. `run_kind` verified landed; row key `(configuration_version_id, run_id)`

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic halves)
- AC-R-2.9.4-1 (schema half): TaskRecord validates disjoint
  visible/held_out/instrument; `HeldOutInEnvironment` refused at import;
  `HeldOutLeak` stays the delivery predicate.
- AC-R-2.9.4-2 (static half): conditioned rule on `suite_id` →
  `BenchmarkConditionedRule` at seal; `applies_to_families` variant admitted.
- AC-R-2.9.6-1: per-home incomplete/debt_class-enum violation refusals;
  `UnknownDebtHome` on unlisted kinds.
- AC-R-2.9.6-2 (static half): `validate_removal_test` refusal battery
  (NotARetirementDiff, MissingMatchSpec, UnresolvedTemplate, unknown probe,
  missing scope.model_selectors).
- AC-R-2.9.6-8: `InsufficientRunway`; `OwnerUnreachable`.
- AC-R-2.9.6-9 (schema half): reflexive/home completeness machinery exists.
- Universal gate: workspace tests green; fmt/clippy clean; build-memory valid.
